topic: Descend forces in a descend glide range.
syllabus_extract: Descend forces in a descend glide range.
specific_objectives: 11.1.3.1 Trainee will be able to describe flight performance of aircraft.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of flight performance charts; Instructor supervision required for chart interpretation.
intro_questions: What are the primary forces acting on an aircraft in flight?
How does the weight vector change when an aircraft enters a glide?
Define the term 'glide range' in the context of helicopter theory.

development.content:
Definition of descend forces
Weight vector orientation in glide
Lift and drag relationship
Thrust absence in glide
Glide angle determination

topics: Effect of weight on glide ratio
development.content:
Calculation of best glide speed
Effect of weight on glide ratio
Wind correction in descent
Energy management during glide
Stall speed in glide configuration

Recovery techniques from glide
Emergency descent procedures
Fuel conservation in glide
Landing zone selection criteria
Final approach alignment

summary_questions: Explain how the absence of engine thrust alters the force equilibrium in a helicopter glide.
Describe the relationship between the glide angle and the lift-to-drag ratio.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the principles of descend forces in a glide range apply to the initial approach phase described in LP 02.
